title: Schematics
description: View the revision-controlled schematic drawings of your panels.

empty.title: Choose a panel
empty.description: Pick a panel above to see its schematics.

viewer.loadErrorDescription: The PDF could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.

tab.rejected: This revision was rejected — it is not valid in the field.

tab.noRevisionTitle: No schematics for this panel yet
tab.noRevisionDescription: Start a draft revision by uploading the first schematic PDF.
tab.removeBody: The sheet will be removed from the draft revision. This cannot be undone.

upload.title: Upload schematics
upload.description: PDF files will be added to the Rev {letter} draft.

upload.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# sheet uploaded} other {# sheets uploaded}}
upload.someFailed: Some files could not be uploaded. You can try again.
